resources.string: look up names of Parley\'s private contacts
Lets the app ask Parley for the name of one phone number at a time, if that number belongs to one of your private contacts. Parley also asks you to approve each app, and never gives out a list.
Medical details and emergency contacts, kept by Android. The lock screen\'s Emergency button shows them.
This phone doesn\'t have Android\'s emergency information. Many phones keep it in Settings, under Safety & emergency.
“In case of emergency”: put the people to call in a label named ICE, so anyone helping you can find them
